faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Got questions? Here are some answers.

advice.question: Does Doni give investment advice?
advice.answer: No. Doni provides information and education only. It never recommends buying or selling a security.

cost.question: How much does Doni cost?
cost.answer: Doni is free during the beta.

data.question: Where do the prices come from?
data.answer: From the BRVM's official bulletin (BOC), published after each trading session. Prices are end-of-day, not real-time.

orders.question: Can I buy or sell securities through Doni?
orders.answer: No. Doni does not receive or route orders. You trade through your SGI and record your trades in Doni.
